name: job-application-autofill
description: Fills job application forms from your saved profile when you click Fill. Never submits.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && CONTENT=fill vite build -c vite.content.config.ts && CONTENT=site vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
scripts.watch: CONTENT=fill vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch & CONTENT=site vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch & vite build --watch
